description: This file contains a series of test scripts designed to validate the behavior of Git rebase operations, including setup of various commit graphs, applying different rebase options, and ensuring correct handling of edge cases like empty commits, disjoint histories, and root rebase scenarios.

methods.name: test_run_rebase
methods.description: A wrapper function to execute various rebase scenarios with expected success or failure outcomes, passing different options to the 'git rebase' command and verifying the resulting commit history.
